summary.text: Jeffrey Roy is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Norfolk District since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney at law.

paragraphs.text: Roy was born in Milford, Massachusetts, graduated from Milford High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Bates College in 1983 and a J.D. from Boston College Law School in 1986.
His career experience includes work as an attorney, and Ballotpedia lists the Franklin Town Council among his prior offices.
He took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on January 2, 2013.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Operations, Facilities and Security and House Post Audit and Oversight committees.
